name: Sphere-Box Intersection Volume via Gaussian Quadrature
definition: Computes the volume of the intersection between a sphere (defined by center and radius) and an axis-aligned bounding box (defined by box_min and box_max) using numerical integration. It handles cases where the sphere is fully inside, fully outside, or partially intersecting the box.
summary: Sphere-Box Intersection Volume via Gaussian Quadrature computes exact intersection volumes using numerical integration, avoiding complex case logic by handling arbitrary partial intersections via 2D Gaussian quadrature.
